card.name: Digit before a decimal point
card.fires_on: A single digit (0, 1, 2, 5) just before a decimal point, ahead of the fractional part. It appears in section cross-references like (5.3) and in decimal doses or table values.

modes.label: Section cross-references
modes.description: Leading digit of a section number in parentheses, such as (5.3) or (1.2).
modes.example: Monitor for Immune Reconstitution Syndrome. ( <<5>>.3 ) 5.1 Skin

modes.label: Decimal values
modes.description: The digit 0 or 1 before the point in a dose or table number.
modes.example: Reduce the dosage of ADCETRIS to <<0>>.9 mg/kg up to a maximum

card.writes: It suppresses sentence-ending periods and newlines, so the model continues the number rather than ending the sentence.
card.plain: It marks a digit that is followed by a decimal point, as in 0.9 or section 5.3, so the number goes on.
